title: Cloud Mac Monitor
background: Closing the window keeps monitoring active. Quit (⌘Q) stops monitoring for this session; the boot preference is preserved.
deleteData: Delete saved account, history and TLS data when uninstalling
serviceState: Boot preference {boot} · system enabled {system} · loaded {loaded} · running {running}
refreshHelp: Refresh the monitor address, network interfaces, and recording status. This does not restart the service.
lanHelp: For phones and other computers on the same network: choose an interface, enable LAN, then create a pairing code. Local monitoring works with LAN disabled.
quitFailed: The service did not confirm shutdown ({code}). The control window will close; monitoring may still be running.
serviceUnavailable: The service is unavailable ({code}). Click Start service; if disabled, enable it at boot first.
browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the monitor address into your browser.
